regions.today: A sunny but blustery day with isolated showers. Fresh, occasionally strong and gusty northwesterly winds will gradually ease to light to moderate westerly this evening.
regions.tonight: Dry with clear spells early tonight with light to moderate southwesterly winds and with just the chance of isolated showers. Cloud will build from the west with rain following overnight and becoming widespread by morning, accompanied by strengthening southerly winds. Lowest temperatures of 3 to 7 degrees.
regions.tomorrow: Storm Boelo tracks to the north of Ireland, bringing another wet and windy day. Rain and fresh to strong and gusty southerly winds, clearing to blustery showers through the afternoon as winds veer westerly and increase strong to near gale force and gusty. Highest temperatures of 13 to 15 degrees.
